paragraphs: They are mentioned in Bava Batra, chapter 6, mishnah 7. Rashbam explains: “It was not specified.”

notes.text: The quoted phrase does not specify who the judges were. The source’s chapter6 mishnah7 locator is retained; the read-only Bava Batra100a lookup did not establish a matching passage.

The saved named Torat Emet Mishnah Bava Batra 6:7 explicitly names the judges of Tzippori; the saved Davidson Bava Batra 100b paragraph quotes that ruling. This locates the supplied Mishnah reference despite the earlier 100a nonmatch. The words attributed to Rashbam remain Hyman’s attribution; no new Rashbam inspection or negative finding is claimed here.

The Rashbam comment is on the Mishnah at Bava Batra 99b, under “The judges of Tzippori.” It says that their identity was not specified. The Mishnah gives their ruling, which the Gemara quotes again on 100b. The earlier note reflects the scope of the previous lookup.
